/*
 * sc_hal_zephyr.c.txt -- REFERENCE Zephyr HAL port (NOT compiled).
 *
 * GENERATED by `schgen scfw` -- DO NOT EDIT.
 *
 * Shipped with a .txt suffix so the firmware/sc/ tree stays strictly
 * toolchain-agnostic (nothing here includes a zephyr/ header).  Copy
 * it to sc_hal_zephyr.c in your Zephyr app, uncomment, and fix the GPIO
 * bank lookup to your board's devicetree.  It implements sc_hal_t over
 * the Zephyr GPIO + I2C APIs and publishes `sc_hal`.
 */
#if 0   /* enable in a Zephyr build */
#include <zephyr/kernel.h>
#include <zephyr/drivers/gpio.h>
#include <zephyr/drivers/i2c.h>
#include "sc_hal.h"

/* One device handle per STM32 GPIO bank the contract uses; the HAL    */
/* maps an sc_gpio_t ('A'..'G', pin) onto (bank, pin).                 */
static const struct device *gpio_bank(char port) {
    switch (port) {
    case 'A': return DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(gpioa));
    case 'B': return DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(gpiob));
    case 'C': return DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(gpioc));
    /* ... D..G as the board provides ... */
    default:  return NULL;
    }
}

static const struct device *i2c_bus =
    DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(i2c_sc));   /* the bit-bang I2C (PA4/PA5) */

static void z_delay_ms(uint32_t ms) { k_msleep(ms); }
static uint32_t z_uptime_ms(void) { return (uint32_t)k_uptime_get(); }

static int z_gpio_cfg_out(sc_gpio_t io, bool od) {
    gpio_flags_t f = GPIO_OUTPUT | (od ? GPIO_OPEN_DRAIN : 0);
    return gpio_pin_configure(gpio_bank(io.port), io.pin, f);
}
static int z_gpio_cfg_in(sc_gpio_t io, bool pu) {
    gpio_flags_t f = GPIO_INPUT | (pu ? GPIO_PULL_UP : 0);
    return gpio_pin_configure(gpio_bank(io.port), io.pin, f);
}
static int z_gpio_set(sc_gpio_t io, bool lvl) {
    return gpio_pin_set(gpio_bank(io.port), io.pin, lvl);
}
static int z_gpio_get(sc_gpio_t io, bool *lvl) {
    int v = gpio_pin_get(gpio_bank(io.port), io.pin);
    if (v < 0) return v; *lvl = (v != 0); return 0;
}
static int z_i2c_xfer(uint8_t addr7, sc_i2c_dir_t dir,
                      uint8_t *buf, size_t len) {
    return (dir == SC_I2C_READ)
        ? i2c_read(i2c_bus, buf, len, addr7)
        : i2c_write(i2c_bus, buf, len, addr7);
}
static int z_wdt_strobe(void) {
    /* toggle the TPS3823 WDI gpio (wdi-gpios in the overlay) */
    return 0;
}
static void z_log(const char *msg) { printk("[sc] %s\n", msg); }

static const sc_hal_t z_hal = {
    .delay_ms = z_delay_ms, .uptime_ms = z_uptime_ms,
    .gpio_configure_output = z_gpio_cfg_out,
    .gpio_configure_input = z_gpio_cfg_in,
    .gpio_set = z_gpio_set, .gpio_get = z_gpio_get,
    .i2c_xfer = z_i2c_xfer, .wdt_strobe = z_wdt_strobe, .log = z_log,
};
const sc_hal_t *sc_hal = &z_hal;
#endif /* 0 */
